{
  "schema_version": "transition_refine_v1",
  "outline": {
    "schema_version": "1.1",
    "chapters": [
      {
        "bridge": {
          "from_prev": "The frontier zone destabilizes following the overseer's defeat.",
          "to_next": "Rhea heads to the city, ready to audit the real powers of the Ledger."
        },
        "chapter_id": 8,
        "chapter_role": "transition",
        "goal": "Loot the overseer's vault, secure the administrative residue as proof, and transition out of the frontier zone toward the civic layer.",
        "pacing": {
          "expected_scene_count": 5,
          "intensity": 3,
          "tempo": "steady"
        },
        "sections": [
          {
            "end_condition": "Rhea secures the administrative residue in her inventory, gaining a permanent, illicit system access token.",
            "intent": "The party loots the collapsing sanctum, securing the 'Mercy Cache' and high-tier administrative residue.",
            "scenes": [
              {
                "characters": [
                  "rhea_mercer",
                  "vance_harrow",
                  "unit_734"
                ],
                "constraint_state": "pursued",
                "handoff_mode": "direct_continuation",
                "hands_off_to": "8:2",
                "location_end": "Vault Threshold",
                "location_end_id": "LOC_VAULT_THRESHOLD_4FFF3B",
                "location_end_label": "Vault Threshold",
                "location_start": "Inner Office",
                "location_start_id": "LOC_INNER_OFFICE_759C53",
                "location_start_label": "Inner Office",
                "outcome": "The party locates and opens the hidden vault, revealing the Mercy Cache before the ceiling caves in.",
                "scene_id": 1,
                "summary": "Rhea, Vance, and Unit 734 navigate the collapsing Inner Office to locate the hidden vault containing the Mercy Cache. They use the coordinates looted from the desk to bypass the final security measure.",
                "threads": [
                  "rhea_survival",
                  "party_alliance"
                ],
                "transition_in_anchors": [
                  "falling masonry",
                  "collapsing Inner Office",
                  "looted coordinates",
                  "wall terminal",
                  "hidden vault"
                ],
                "transition_in_text": "Dodging chunks of falling masonry in the collapsing Inner Office, Rhea inputs the looted coordinates into the wall terminal to reveal the hidden vault.",
                "transition_out_anchors": [
                  "heavy stone panel",
                  "dark threshold",
                  "vault",
                  "massive support beam",
                  "crashing debris"
                ],
                "transition_out_text": "The heavy stone panel grinds open, revealing the dark threshold of the vault just as a massive support beam crashes behind them.",
                "type": "puzzle"
              },
              {
                "characters": [
                  "rhea_mercer",
                  "vance_harrow",
                  "unit_734"
                ],
                "constraint_state": "fleeing",
                "consumes_outcome_from": "8:1",
                "end_condition_echo": "Rhea secures the administrative residue in her inventory, gaining a permanent, illicit system access token.",
                "handoff_mode": "direct_continuation",
                "hands_off_to": "8:3",
                "location_end": "Vault Interior",
                "location_end_id": "LOC_VAULT_INTERIOR_21D9A3",
                "location_end_label": "Vault Interior",
                "location_start": "Vault Threshold",
                "location_start_id": "LOC_VAULT_THRESHOLD_4FFF3B",
                "location_start_label": "Vault Threshold",
                "outcome": "Rhea secures the administrative residue in her inventory, gaining a permanent, illicit system access token.",
                "scene_id": 2,
                "summary": "Inside the vault, Rhea secures the administrative residue—a glowing, illicit system access token—stowing it in her inventory. Vance grabs a handful of high-tier restorative consumables just as the vault's structural integrity fails.",
                "threads": [
                  "rhea_survival",
                  "system_debt_trap"
                ],
                "transition_in_anchors": [
                  "vault interior",
                  "glowing administrative residue",
                  "central pedestal",
                  "stone threshold"
                ],
                "transition_in_text": "Rhea steps over the threshold into the vault interior, her eyes locking onto the glowing administrative residue resting on a central pedestal.",
                "transition_out_anchors": [
                  "glowing token",
                  "inventory",
                  "vault ceiling",
                  "deafening crack",
                  "buckling stone"
                ],
                "transition_out_text": "She shoves the glowing token deep into her inventory just as the vault ceiling begins to buckle inward with a deafening crack.",
                "type": "progression"
              }
            ],
            "section_id": 1,
            "title": "Looting the Cache"
          },
          {
            "end_condition": "The party successfully crosses the boundary out of the frontier zone just as it collapses behind them.",
            "intent": "The frontier zone begins to purge and reset, forcing the party to flee toward the civic layer boundary.",
            "scenes": [
              {
                "characters": [
                  "rhea_mercer",
                  "vance_harrow",
                  "unit_734"
                ],
                "constraint_state": "fleeing",
                "consumes_outcome_from": "8:2",
                "handoff_mode": "direct_continuation",
                "hands_off_to": "8:4",
                "location_end": "Frontier Boundary",
                "location_end_id": "LOC_FRONTIER_BOUNDARY_A0C17A",
                "location_end_label": "Frontier Boundary",
                "location_start": "Vault Interior",
                "location_start_id": "LOC_VAULT_INTERIOR_21D9A3",
                "location_start_label": "Vault Interior",
                "outcome": "The party escapes the collapsing sanctum and reaches the outer boundary of the frontier zone.",
                "scene_id": 3,
                "summary": "The frontier zone initiates a hard purge protocol, dissolving the sanctum's architecture into raw code. The party sprints through the disintegrating corridors, dodging falling debris and deletion waves.",
                "threads": [
                  "rhea_survival",
                  "party_alliance"
                ],
                "transition_in_anchors": [
                  "buckling vault",
                  "dissolving corridors",
                  "raw red deletion code",
                  "sprinting party"
                ],
                "transition_in_text": "Sprinting back out of the buckling vault, the party races through corridors that are actively dissolving into streams of raw, red deletion code.",
                "transition_out_anchors": [
                  "disintegrating archway",
                  "jagged edge",
                  "Frontier Boundary",
                  "spilling group"
                ],
                "transition_out_text": "Vance shoulders through the final disintegrating archway, spilling the group out onto the jagged edge of the Frontier Boundary.",
                "type": "action"
              },
              {
                "characters": [
                  "rhea_mercer",
                  "vance_harrow",
                  "unit_734"
                ],
                "constraint_state": "free",
                "consumes_outcome_from": "8:3",
                "end_condition_echo": "The party successfully crosses the boundary out of the frontier zone just as it collapses behind them.",
                "handoff_mode": "arrival_checkpoint",
                "hands_off_to": "8:5",
                "location_end": "Civic Outskirts",
                "location_end_id": "LOC_CIVIC_OUTSKIRTS_F601F2",
                "location_end_label": "Civic Outskirts",
                "location_start": "Frontier Boundary",
                "location_start_id": "LOC_FRONTIER_BOUNDARY_A0C17A",
                "location_start_label": "Frontier Boundary",
                "outcome": "The party successfully crosses the boundary out of the frontier zone just as it collapses behind them.",
                "scene_id": 4,
                "summary": "At the edge of the frontier zone, a massive firewall of deletion code threatens to consume them. Rhea uses her newly acquired access token to force a temporary breach in the boundary, allowing Vance and Unit 734 to slip through before diving in herself.",
                "threads": [
                  "rhea_survival",
                  "system_debt_trap"
                ],
                "transition_in_anchors": [
                  "massive firewall",
                  "deletion code",
                  "Frontier Boundary",
                  "access token",
                  "interface node"
                ],
                "transition_in_text": "Staring down a massive firewall of deletion code at the Frontier Boundary, Rhea jams her new access token into the boundary's interface node.",
                "transition_out_anchors": [
                  "parted firewall",
                  "breach",
                  "cold paved stone",
                  "Civic Outskirts",
                  "tumbling body"
                ],
                "transition_out_text": "The firewall parts just long enough for Rhea to dive through the breach, tumbling onto the cold, paved stone of the Civic Outskirts.",
                "type": "dramatic"
              }
            ],
            "section_id": 2,
            "title": "Outrunning the Purge"
          },
          {
            "end_condition": "Rhea receives a new, high-stakes System prompt welcoming her to the civic layer, setting up Book 2.",
            "intent": "Rhea and her party look toward the vast, institutional city, ready to scale their exploits.",
            "scenes": [
              {
                "characters": [
                  "rhea_mercer",
                  "vance_harrow",
                  "unit_734"
                ],
                "constraint_state": "free",
                "consumes_outcome_from": "8:4",
                "end_condition_echo": "Rhea receives a new, high-stakes System prompt welcoming her to the civic layer, setting up Book 2.",
                "handoff_mode": "arrival_checkpoint",
                "location_end": "Civic Outskirts",
                "location_end_id": "LOC_CIVIC_OUTSKIRTS_F601F2",
                "location_end_label": "Civic Outskirts",
                "location_start": "Civic Outskirts",
                "location_start_id": "LOC_CIVIC_OUTSKIRTS_F601F2",
                "location_start_label": "Civic Outskirts",
                "outcome": "Rhea receives a new, high-stakes System prompt welcoming her to the civic layer, setting up Book 2.",
                "scene_id": 5,
                "summary": "The party catches their breath on a high ridge overlooking a sprawling, impossibly vast institutional city governed by the Ledger. As Rhea surveys the towering spires of bureaucracy, a high-stakes System prompt flashes before her eyes, formally welcoming her to the civic layer and registering her illicit token.",
                "threads": [
                  "rhea_survival",
                  "system_debt_trap"
                ],
                "transition_in_anchors": [
                  "cold paved stone",
                  "Civic Outskirts",
                  "sprawling institutional city",
                  "gasping breath"
                ],
                "transition_in_text": "Gasping for air on the cold paved stone of the Civic Outskirts, Rhea pushes herself up to look at the sprawling, impossibly vast institutional city below.",
                "type": "progression"
              }
            ],
            "section_id": 3,
            "title": "The Civic Layer"
          }
        ],
        "stakes_shift": "From conquering the tutorial to entering the vastly more dangerous institutional world.",
        "title": "Institutional Access"
      }
    ]
  },
  "phase_report": {
    "candidate_seams": [],
    "edits_applied": [
      "Verified all transitions are continuous and require no seam resolution."
    ],
    "transition_hint_compliance": []
  }
}
